headline: Presidents Cup Day 2 at Medinah: USA and Internationals battle on Course No. 3
whyCareReason: Day 2 at Medinah brings intense team match play as Brandt Snedeker's Americans defend their lead against Geoff Ogilvy's International squad.

story:
Why this one matters: Following Thursday's opening encounters, the 16th Presidents Cup hits high gear Friday at Medinah Country Club in Illinois on the newly contoured Course No. 3.

PGA Tour and PresidentsCup.com report that captains Brandt Snedeker and Geoff Ogilvy have sent out their top pairings for Friday's session. World No. 1 Scottie Scheffler and Russell Henley take on Adam Scott and Hideki Matsuyama, while Patrick Cantlay and Xander Schauffele duel Jason Day and Sungjae Im.

With Medinah's strategic OCM-redesigned greens placing a premium on precision and poise, Friday points carry massive weight before the weekend singles and four-balls.
stakes: The United States defends their long-standing supremacy, while the International side seeks their first triumph in 28 years.
rivalryAngle: Team USA dominance versus International determination on Chicago's most famous championship stage.
